blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( XLT-i and i17 with duplex bearings)
Disassemble the power end ( XLT-i and i17 with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: Remove the bolts (371C), the end cover (109A), and the gasket (360C).

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( XLT-i and i17 with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: If  necessary, remove the outboard labyrinth oil seal (332A) from the end cover (109A) and remove the O-rings (497F and 497G).

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( XLT-i and i17 with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: Labyrinth oil-seal O-rings are part of  the 3196 maintenance kits, or they are sold separately.

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( XLT-i and i17 with duplex bearings)
Disassemble the power end ( XLT-i and i17 with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: Remove the bearing housing (134) and bearings (112A) from the shaft (122) .

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( XLT-i and i17 with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: Remove the bearing locknut (136), the bearing lockwasher (382), and the outboard bearing (112A).

blocks.section: Disassemble the power end ( XLT-i and i17 with duplex bearings)
Disassemble the power end ( XLT-i and i17 with duplex bearings)
blocks.content: NOTICE: Use force only on the inner race when you press bearings off  the shaft. Do not use force in situations in which you might break a part. Doing so may result in equipment damage.
Save the bearings for inspection. Do not reuse the bearings. Doing so may result in decreased performance.
